entries.question: Mai up se Lakhimpur kheri se huApke yha dmlt course ke admission kaise hoga
entries.answer:

For the most current information on DMLT admissions, including eligibility criteria, important dates, and the application process, please refer to the official KGMU website or contact the KGMU Institute of Paramedical Sciences directly.

You can find admission-related information on the KGMU website at: [https://www.kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php](https://www.kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php)

*   **Phone:** 9450906485
